metadata.title: The AI Inner Circle
metadata.scope: A curated historical relationship catalogue with an ongoing expansion of source-backed links; affiliations describe cited sources, not a live staff directory.
metadata.original_prototype: Not available in supplied attachment or inspected workspace; independently reconstructed.
metadata.projection: Unweighted undirected simple graph; direction and parallel relationship records retained in source data.
metadata.temporal_rule: Year filter shows ties with a documented start no later than the cutoff; unknown start optional. Historical ties persist. It is not an active-at-date graph.
metadata.affiliation_projection: Separate person–institution records. Shared affiliation alone is not a direct interpersonal relationship and never enters person-only paths or centralities.

affiliations.coverage: Reviewed profiles remain partial histories; unrecorded degrees, jobs and memberships are unknown, not absent.

comparison_industry: Not constructed; this sample cannot establish unusual concentration relative to other industries.
